name: Sticheln
summary: A 4-player Austrian trick-taking game where players win chips from a pot for each trick taken.
rules_text: Played with 32 cards (A K Q J 10 9 8 7) ranking Ace high. Decide seating and first dealer by cutting. Dealer puts 8 chips in the pot, shuffles, left-hand player cuts, bottom card of top half is turned as trump and belongs to dealer. Deal 8 cards each in two packets of four anti-clockwise. Forehand leads first trick, winner of each trick leads next. Must follow suit if able, must trump if unable to follow, otherwise may play any card. You must head the trick (play a higher card than current winner) if you can. Each trick won pays 1 chip from pot to winner. After deal, forehand becomes dealer and pays 8 chips to new pot. Play continues for an agreed number of rounds of 4 deals or until a player reaches a target chip total.
